assets.asset: raw call capture and temporary transcript
tour location, offline pack, notes, photos, Pencil strokes
audit, engineering-request, release, and verification evidence

trust_boundaries.boundary: future public site to private Workspace
trust_boundaries.rule: Separate origin, session, authorization audience, storage, and API data.

trust_boundaries.boundary: browser/native client to Cloudflare product API
trust_boundaries.rule: Typed API, authenticated exact object authorization, CSRF/origin or PKCE, safe errors.
Separate automation actor, scoped context, strict output schema, exact IDs, no partner cookie inheritance.
Only safe opaque operational summaries cross; business payload stays in Workspace.

trust_boundaries.boundary: device local storage to sync service
trust_boundaries.rule: Encrypted cache/outbox, device attribution, idempotency, version conflicts, revocation invalidation.

trust_boundaries.boundary: raw local capture to structured record queue
trust_boundaries.rule: No raw transcript/audio/email body/unrestricted verb payload enters the candidate queue.
Minimum data, supported APIs, replaceable adapters, contractual privacy review, explicit share/import.

threats.abuse: Unauthorized or public user learns private record data or existence.
CSRF, sibling-origin abuse, token replay, or lost device performs a write.
Doc or agent inherits partner authority and performs consequential work.
Model invents an ID, selects the wrong record, or treats ambiguous speaker identity as fact.
Prompt injection in transcript, document, email, or web content changes tool behavior or exfiltrates data.
Sensitive data leaks through logs, screenshots, telemetry, caches, model prompts, or screen sharing.
Offline or stale device silently overwrites newer partner work or loses acknowledged tour evidence.
Recording begins without consent, uncertain speaker is guessed, or raw capture persists indefinitely.
Draft escapes into email send, publishing, spend, or audience change.
System work displays Completed without fresh tests/read-back or exposes engineering internals to Workspace.
OAuth/session write churn exhausts Cloudflare KV and locks out users.
mitigations: choose paid or alternative storage only after evidence

threats.abuse: Old surfaces and new Workspace both write, creating divergent truth.
